issues.evidence: On-board I2C bus SCL/SDA (nRF P0.02/P0.03 to QMC5883L U6 pins 1/16) has no resistor to any supply; only the nRF52 internal ~13k pull-ups can be used
issues.why_it_matters: Weak internal pull-ups give slow edges; marginal at 400 kHz and noise-sensitive

issues.evidence: LSM6DS3 INT1 (pin 4) drives label IMU_INT, which reaches no other pin (no MCU GPIO)
issues.why_it_matters: IMU data-ready/wake interrupt unusable; firmware must poll over SPI (more power)

issues.evidence: nRF52 P0.22 (pin 27) is connected directly to GND
issues.why_it_matters: If firmware ever configures P0.22 as output-high it shorts the pin to ground; unused GPIO should be left open or tied via resistor

issues.evidence: QMC5883L reference circuit uses C1 = 4.7 uF and SETP-SETC = 0.22 uF; board uses 2.2 uF (C15) and 100 nF (C18)
issues.why_it_matters: Reduced set/reset pulse energy can degrade magnetometer offset/heading accuracy

issues.evidence: D3 value 'D' and F1 value 'Fuse' are symbol defaults; only JLC part numbers identify them
issues.why_it_matters: Rating of the battery protection fuse/clamp is not reviewable from the schematic

issues.evidence: U2 value nRF52810-QFxx on nRF52832 symbol (project is named nRF52832); U3 XC6206P332 on MCP1703A symbol (pinout GND/VO/VI matches)
issues.why_it_matters: Ambiguous which MCU is fitted (flash/RAM differ)

acceptable_designs.reason: Battery connectors feed fuse F1 then shunt diode D3 to GND (fuse + clamp crowbar on reverse polarity), then MT9700 load switch U4
SWD pogo pads; 3V3 is target-reference for debugger
Common-anode RGB LED with 2k series resistor per cathode to GPIO
DEC2 is unused on QFN48 nRF52; reset has internal pull-up; no 32 kHz crystal (LFRC used); unused GPIOs
LSM6DS3 SDx/SCx auxiliary I2C master pins grounded when unused, per datasheet
nRF52 DEC1 100nF, DEC3 100pF, DEC4 2.2uF with DC/DC L1 10uH + L2 15nH per Nordic reference
AD8293 IN- and REF both on the J1 electrode biased at ~1.1 V by R1/R4 divider: intentional mid-supply reference for single-supply EMG
Push-button OR MCU SYS_ON drives load-switch enable; BT_OUT pulled down via R6+R7 and sensed on P0.19 at safe ~3.4 V

notes: uMyo wireless EMG: AD8293G80 in-amp with dry electrodes, nRF52 (value says nRF52810), LSM6DS3 IMU on SPI, QMC5883L magnetometer on I2C, XC6206 LDO, MT9700 soft-power switch. RF and nRF52 DC/DC follow the Nordic reference. Main gaps: no I2C pull-ups and IMU interrupt not routed.
